summary: VapePOS Phase 1 unified MVP (customer portal + universal login + kiosk lock + notifications + privacy) fully validated. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass in new /app/backend/tests/test_mvp_unified.py covering universal-login routing, customer register 18+/CGU/duplicate gates, profile update with password guard, account deletion with sales anonymisation, verify-pin (1111 ok, 9999 rejected), notifications for customer + staff contexts, mark-read, and sale-triggered customer notification. Frontend: audience toggle (Client default) + register/login sub-tabs work; adult signup redirects to /client/me; bottom-nav 4 tabs (Accueil/Mon QR/Achats/Profil) render with correct data-testid; QR page shows QR + brightness tip + regenerate; Profile page shows edit, password, delete zone; /privacy accessible unauthenticated with return button; POS kiosk lock button toggles, ribbon 'Mode bloqué actif' appears, wrong PIN 9999 shows error, correct PIN 1111 unlocks; notification bell in POS + client header opens popover.

issues: Task spec says 'menu Gestion et Logout masqués'. The account chip (Mathis ADMIN) and 'Caisse' link still appear in the header when locked. Ribbon and 'Verrouillé' button work but the account/logout menu (opened by the account chip) may still be reachable — recommend hiding the account-chip menu trigger or disabling its dropdown items when kiosk locked.

action_items: (minor UI) Hide or disable the account-chip dropdown items (Gestion, Logout) when kiosk mode is active — currently 'Mathis ADMIN' chip remains clickable in header while locked.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still 1879 lines — split into routers (auth/customer/notifications/sales) recommended.

customer_register: when upgrading an existing in-store customer (no password_hash) to a portal account, no 18+ age check is enforced against pre-existing birth_date — but body.birth_date IS checked so acceptable. However the welcome notification is only sent on brand-new insert branch, not on upgrade — inconsistent UX.

GET /notifications iterates two auth contexts by catching HTTPException — acceptable but relies on current_user raising HTTPException(401). If middleware changes to return default anonymous user, both branches could match. Consider explicit token-source check.

customer/register returns password_hash-free doc via projection AND set_customer_cookie; but the response includes token in both cookie AND body — fine, but ensure CORS allow_credentials=true so cookie is actually used by SPA cross-origin (currently browser stores it on the frontend origin only if SameSite=None+Secure — verify prod).
KioskLock persists in localStorage only — a determined user could open devtools and clear it. Acceptable for MVP but document as 'soft-lock'.
customer/account DELETE marks sales with _orphan_customer=true but doesn't purge that flag from responses — leaks internal field to /api/sales listings when staff views history.
test_credentials: Staff Mathis PIN 1111 / password vapepos. Customers created dynamically via /customer/register with birth_date 1995-01-01.
seed_data_creation: Each backend test creates a unique testclient_<ts>_<uuid>@ex.com customer + at least one sale for TestSaleNotification and TestAccountDeletion. Customers are deleted in the delete test; the notification test's customer + welcome/sale notifications persist (minor).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_mvp_unified.py + test_multi_store_v3.py are the canonical regression suites. Run with `-o addopts=''` to override the parallel-xdist config in backend/pytest.ini which lacks xdist. Kiosk-lock unlock relies on POST /api/auth/verify-pin — do not regress. Customer JWT is delivered both in cookie and Authorization header; tests use the header.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical bugs. Only one minor UX polish item (account chip visible in header while kiosk locked).
